title: Limb Bottom Cap UV Fix (Mixins Registry Patch)
summary: Corrected texture UV coordinates on the bottom cap of forearms and shins to fix mismatched green textures on wrists/soles, and registered the new ModelPartAccessor in the mixins configuration.
notes: Aligns forearm bottom caps with original wrist texture
Aligns shin bottom caps with original boot sole texture
Registers ModelPartAccessor in eclipseclient.mixins.json to prevent classload exceptions on startup
